about: Grades and what the fold makes of them (docs/adr/0013): a table per channel (R, G, B; 256 entries, the output for input i / 255, 0..1) and a colour matrix (rows R, G, B of weights on the input's R, G, B), each null when it changes nothing; then the sharpen and vignette amounts (0..100, 0 for none). A Grade with a Look gives the Look's Adjust values inline (`look`). One with an Imported Look names its fitted tables and matrix (`fit`, in `fits`) and expects `lut`: the Look and its intensity (the fit passed through), or null. Read by backend/tests/test_grade_fold.py and frontend/src/pages/job/editor/grading.test.ts, so that the render's fold (backend/app/grading.py) and the preview's (grading.ts) can't drift. Written from the backend's fold when its maths changes.
